faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications is 25 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees. For Engineering/IT/CS, a Four Years Graduate Degree is accepted. Desirable qualifications include knowledge of Psychology/Public Health and experience in multicentric projects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per ICMR guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is ₹56,000 per month, plus 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA), totaling ₹67,200 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) position at AIIMS Gorakhpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Gorakhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided online application link.

faq.question: Q9. When did the application process start?
faq.answer: The application process started on 10 September 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where is AIIMS Gorakhpur located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Gorakhpur is located in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh. However, the notification mentions applications are invited from eligible candidates in Hyderabad, which might refer to a specific project location or administrative context.
